4452-6495-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-6495-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 3.
4452-6495-6871-6879.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-4314--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-4314--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

643-3951-4247-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-4247-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-4019-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2738-4314-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2248-3257-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

553-4838-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Najal.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2921-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2921-4302-5929.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1987-7089-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-7089-7487.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

856-4321-5686-7422.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Food.
You control at least one additional creature.
856-4321-5686-7422.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food and Blood token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

2105-7175-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

457-1458-4404-6000.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-6000.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-1887-2060-2292-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

3129-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
3129-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
3129-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with an opponent chosen

1055-6497-7268.description:
Cast Kitsune's Technique by paying its mana cost, causing the opponent named by Sewer Nemesis to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, milling the remainder of their library.
1055-6497-7268.notes: If able, you can instead cast Kitsune's Technique for its sneak cost, reducing the needed mana by {3}{U}.

339-677-6791-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-6791-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-6633-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2079-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2079-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3490-4289-4927-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-4927-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

104-3490-5231-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-6097.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4484-6112-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-6112-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1844-5571-6797--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-5571-6797--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4681-6132.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat form step 2.

1580-2511-4647-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2867-4636-5315-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

116-215-729-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
116-215-729-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Kiora's Follower any number of times.

654-1541-2034-2556-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, adding {C}{C}.
When Mnemonic Wall dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Mnemonic Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Mnemonic Wall from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Mnemonic Wall and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Mnemonic Wall triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1562-2781.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}.
Choose to have Machine God's Effigy enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian, except it's an artifact.
When Machine God's Effigy enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Machine God's Effigy.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1778-2232-4488.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1518-1987-3227-3941.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3227-3941.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

3263-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, allowing you to exile Leonin Relic-Warder due to Mycosynth Lattice.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its last ability triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
